title: Ancient Whale Fossil from Hengchun Goes on Show
summaryZh: 恆春半島出土十萬年前鯨魚化石，11月1日首度展出
summaryHi: हेंगचुन से मिला 1,00,000 साल पुराना व्हेल जीवाश्म 1 नवंबर से प्रदर्शित
summaryEs: Un fósil de ballena de hace 100.000 años hallado en Hengchun se expone desde el 1 de noviembre
summaryJa: 恒春半島で見つかった10万年前のクジラ化石、11月1日に初公開
summaryKo: 헝춘반도에서 발견된 10만 년 전 고래 화석, 11월 1일 첫 공개
summaryEn: A 100,000-year-old whale fossil found on the Hengchun Peninsula goes on display on November 1.
paragraphs: A remarkably complete prehistoric whale fossil unearthed on the Hengchun Peninsula will go on public display for the first time on 1 November at the National Museum of Marine Biology and Aquarium in Pingtung County.

The remains were spotted in July 2025 by local fossil collector Lin Ching-wen during one of his regular searches on the western side of the peninsula. Excavating and collecting the bones took four months.

The animal measured about 6 metres, and more than 80% of its skeleton is preserved. The team recovered over 130 specimens, among them parts of the skull and upper jaw, a complete lower jaw, a long section of the backbone, most of the ribs and nearly an entire shoulder blade.

Based on the bones, researchers suspect the whale belonged to the right whale family. Because some vertebrae still had unfused growth plates, it was most likely a juvenile when it died, roughly 100,000 years ago.

It is the second large whale fossil found nearby in recent years, after an even bigger skeleton was discovered in 2022. The museum says such finds help explain how the area changed from ancient seabed to dry land.
A very old whale is coming to a museum in southern Taiwan. It is not a living whale. It is a fossil, made of old bones in rock.
A man called Lin Ching-wen found it in July last year. He looks for fossils near Hengchun, in Pingtung County. The work to dig out the bones took four months.
The whale was about 6 metres long. Most of its body is there: the head, the jaw, the back and many ribs. It was a young whale when it died.
Scientists think it lived about 100,000 years ago. At that time, the sea covered this land.
You can see the fossil at the National Museum of Marine Biology and Aquarium from 1 November.
sentZh: 一隻非常古老的鯨魚要來到台灣南部的一間博物館。
牠不是活的鯨魚。
牠是化石，由石頭裡的古老骨頭構成。
一位名叫林景文的男子在去年七月發現了它。
他在屏東縣恆春附近尋找化石。
把骨頭挖出來的工作花了四個月。
這隻鯨魚大約6公尺長。
牠大部分的身體都還在：頭、下巴、背部和許多肋骨。
牠死的時候還是一隻年輕的鯨魚。
科學家認為牠生活在大約十萬年前。
那時候，海水覆蓋著這片土地。
從11月1日起，你可以在國立海洋生物博物館看到這具化石。

paragraphs: A nearly complete whale fossil found in southern Taiwan will be shown to the public for the first time on 1 November.
Local fossil collector Lin Ching-wen discovered the bones in July 2025 while searching on the western side of the Hengchun Peninsula. Digging them out and collecting them took four months.

The whale was around 6 metres long, and more than 80% of its skeleton has survived. Workers recovered over 130 pieces, including part of the skull, a complete lower jaw, most of the ribs and almost a whole shoulder bone.
Experts believe it may belong to the right whale family. Some of its bones had not finished growing, so it was probably young. The museum thinks it lived about 100,000 years ago.

The fossil will go on display at the National Museum of Marine Biology and Aquarium in Pingtung County. It is the second large whale found in the area in recent years. An even bigger one was found in 2022.
sentZh: 一具在台灣南部發現、幾乎完整的鯨魚化石，將在11月1日首次對大眾展出。
當地化石收藏家林景文於2025年7月在恆春半島西側搜尋時發現了這些骨頭。
把它們挖出並收集起來花了四個月。
這隻鯨魚大約6公尺長，超過80%的骨骼保存了下來。
工作人員找回了130多件標本，包括部分頭骨、完整的下顎、大部分的肋骨和幾乎完整的肩胛骨。
專家認為牠可能屬於露脊鯨科。
牠的一些骨頭還沒有長完，所以牠可能還很年輕。
博物館認為牠生活在大約十萬年前。
這具化石將在屏東縣的國立海洋生物博物館展出。
這是近年來在該地區發現的第二隻大型鯨魚。
2022年還發現過一隻更大的鯨魚。

The remains were spotted in July 2025 by local fossil collector Lin Ching-wen during one of his regular searches on the western side of the peninsula. Excavating and collecting the bones took four months.

sentZh: 一具在恆春半島出土、保存得相當完整的史前鯨魚化石，將於11月1日在屏東縣國立海洋生物博物館首次公開展出。
這些遺骸是當地化石收藏家林景文於2025年7月在半島西側例行搜尋時發現的。
挖掘和收集這些骨頭花了四個月。
這隻動物大約6公尺長，超過80%的骨骼被保存下來。
團隊找回了130多件標本，其中包括部分頭骨和上顎、完整的下顎、一長段脊椎骨、大部分肋骨以及幾乎整片肩胛骨。
研究人員根據骨頭推測，這隻鯨魚屬於露脊鯨科。
由於部分脊椎骨的生長板尚未癒合，牠在大約十萬年前死亡時很可能還是幼鯨。
這是近年來附近發現的第二具大型鯨魚化石，在此之前，2022年曾發現一具更大的骨骼。
博物館表示，這類發現有助於說明該地區如何從古代海床變成陸地。

paragraphs: Visitors to the National Museum of Marine Biology and Aquarium in Pingtung County will soon be able to come face to face with a creature that swam off Taiwan's southern tip some 100,000 years ago. A strikingly intact whale fossil goes on show there for the first time on 1 November.

The skeleton was stumbled upon in July 2025 by amateur collector Lin Ching-wen, who routinely combs the western flank of the Hengchun Peninsula for remains. Painstaking excavation took a further four months.

Measuring roughly 6 metres, the whale has more than 80% of its skeleton intact. Among the 130-plus specimens retrieved are portions of the skull and upper jaw, a complete lower jaw, a run of vertebrae from neck to lower back, most of the ribs and an almost whole shoulder blade.
Researchers tentatively assign it to the right whale family. Unfused growth plates in several vertebrae indicate that the animal had not reached adulthood.
The discovery follows the 2022 unearthing of an even larger whale in the same district, and curators say it sheds fresh light on how a former marine environment was gradually transformed into land.
sentZh: 前往屏東縣國立海洋生物博物館的遊客，很快就能和一種約十萬年前在台灣南端外海游動的生物面對面。
一具驚人完整的鯨魚化石將於11月1日首次在那裡展出。
這具骨骼是業餘收藏家林景文於2025年7月偶然發現的，他經常在恆春半島西側仔細搜尋遺骸。
費心的挖掘工作又花了四個月。
這隻鯨魚長約6公尺，超過80%的骨骼完好。
在找回的130多件標本中，有部分頭骨和上顎、完整的下顎、從頸部到下背的一連串脊椎骨、大部分肋骨，以及幾乎完整的肩胛骨。
研究人員暫時將牠歸類為露脊鯨科。
幾節脊椎骨中尚未癒合的生長板顯示，這隻動物還沒有成年。
在此之前，2022年曾在同一地區出土一隻更大的鯨魚，策展人表示，這次的發現讓人更加了解過去的海洋環境如何逐漸轉變成陸地。

paragraphs: A prehistoric whale fossil of unusual completeness is set to be exhibited publicly for the first time on 1 November at the National Museum of Marine Biology and Aquarium in Pingtung County, southern Taiwan.

The find was made in July 2025 by Lin Ching-wen, a local enthusiast who regularly searches the western coast of the Hengchun Peninsula. Extracting and documenting the remains subsequently required four months of meticulous work.

Approximately 6 metres in length, the specimen retains over 80% of its skeleton. More than 130 fragments were recovered, encompassing sections of the skull and upper jaw, an intact lower jaw, a continuous series of vertebrae, the majority of the ribs and a virtually complete shoulder blade.
Anatomical evidence suggests that the whale was a member of the right whale family, while unfused growth plates imply that it was still immature at the time of death, an estimated 100,000 years ago.

Significantly, this is the second substantial whale skeleton to emerge from the area since 2022. Scientists argue that such discoveries provide valuable evidence of how the region evolved from a marine habitat into the landscape visible today.
sentZh: 一具完整度罕見的史前鯨魚化石，即將於11月1日在台灣南部屏東縣的國立海洋生物博物館首次公開展出。
這項發現是由當地愛好者林景文於2025年7月完成的，他經常在恆春半島西岸搜尋。
之後，挖掘並記錄這些遺骸需要四個月的細心工作。
這件標本長約6公尺，保留了超過80%的骨骼。
共找回超過130件碎片，包括部分頭骨和上顎、完整的下顎、一連串連續的脊椎骨、大部分肋骨以及幾乎完整的肩胛骨。
解剖學證據顯示這隻鯨魚屬於露脊鯨科，而未癒合的生長板則意味著牠在大約十萬年前死亡時尚未成熟。
值得注意的是，這是自2022年以來該地區出土的第二具大型鯨魚骨骼。
科學家認為，這類發現提供了寶貴的證據，說明該地區如何從海洋棲地演變成今天所見的地貌。

regular.zh: 定期的（on a regular basis：定期地）

remains.ex: The shop remains open until late.

required.en: needed or demanded by a rule
required.ex: Passports are required for all travellers.

retrieved.ex: Divers retrieved the phone from the lake.

ribs.ex: He broke two ribs in the fall.

right.ex: You were right about the weather.

rock.en: the hard material of the earth
rock.ex: The old bones were hidden inside the rock.

routinely.ex: Pilots routinely check the plane before flying.

say.ex: Gardaí say more people died this year.

says.ex: Experts say the plan will work.

scientists.ex: Scientists are studying the new virus.

sea.en: a large area of salt water

seabed.ex: Divers found an old wreck on the seabed.

searches.ex: His searches found nothing for weeks.

searching.ex: They spent hours searching for the keys.

second.ex: This is my second visit to Paris.

section.ex: A section of the roof fell in.

see.ex: He will see out his contract.

series.en: a number of similar things in order
series.ex: There was a series of meetings.

set.en: set up: start; set out: explain clearly
set.ex: The club was set up in 1980.

sheds.ex: The letter sheds light on his early life.

shoulder.en: accept a heavy cost or duty
shoulder.ex: Parents shoulder most of the costs.

shown.en: put somewhere for people to see
shown.ex: The paintings will be shown in May.

side.en: side effects: extra results, usually bad
side.ex: The plan had bad side effects.

significantly.ex: Prices have risen significantly this year.

skeleton.en: all the bones of a body together
skeleton.ex: The museum shows a dinosaur skeleton.

so.ex: It was raining, so we stayed home.

some.ex: Some fifty people came to the meeting.

southern.ex: They live in a southern farming village.

specimen.en: a single example of a type of animal
specimen.ex: The museum has a large specimen of a shark.

specimens.en: examples or pieces kept for scientific study (specimen)
specimens.ex: The lab stores thousands of insect specimens.

spotted.ex: A fox was spotted in the garden.

still.ex: She is still waiting for the bus.

strikingly.en: in a way that is very noticeable

stumbled.ja: 偶然見つけた；つまずいた
stumbled.ex: We stumbled upon a quiet beach.

example.en: The road was closed and subsequently repaired.

note.usage: 正式連接詞，用於敘述時間順序。

noteHi.exampleTr: सड़क बंद हुई और बाद में ठीक की गई।

noteEs.exampleTr: La carretera se cerró y posteriormente se reparó.

noteJa.exampleTr: 道路は閉鎖され、その後修理された。
noteJa.usage: 堅い語。時間の順序を示す。

substantial.ex: The new road needs a substantial amount of money.

example.en: The town received a substantial grant.
example.zh: 小鎮獲得一筆可觀的補助。

note.usage: IELTS 常用來取代 big/large；a substantial increase/sum。

noteHi.exampleTr: शहर को एक बड़ा अनुदान मिला।
noteHi.usage: big/large के स्थान पर; a substantial sum/increase।

noteEs.exampleTr: El pueblo recibió una subvención considerable.
noteEs.usage: Sustituye a big/large; a substantial sum.

noteJa.exampleTr: 町は多額の補助金を受けた。
noteJa.usage: big/large の言い換え。a substantial increase。

such.en: of this kind; such as: for example

suggests.en: shows that something is probably true
suggests.ex: The data suggests people are buying less.

survived.en: managed to continue after a test
survived.ex: The plan survived a tough vote.

suspect.en: to think something is probably true
suspect.ex: I suspect the shop is already closed.

swam.en: moved through water using arms and legs

taiwan.en: an island country in East Asia

tentatively.en: in a careful, not yet certain way
tentatively.ex: The meeting is tentatively set for Tuesday.

example.en: The meeting is tentatively set for Friday.

noteEn.meaning: in a way that is not yet certain or final.

noteHi.exampleTr: बैठक अस्थायी रूप से शुक्रवार को तय है।
noteHi.meaning: अभी पक्का नहीं; अस्थायी रूप से।

noteEs.exampleTr: La reunión está fijada provisionalmente para el viernes.

noteJa.exampleTr: 会議は暫定的に金曜日に決まっている。

there.ex: We went to the park and played there.

think.ex: Experts think a deal is possible.

thinks.ex: He thinks the film is too long.

time.ex: For the first time, dentists will join.

tip.ex: The house is on the tip of the island.

today.ex: Today there are fewer than 70 growers.

took.ex: The ban took effect last year.

transformed.ex: The city has transformed in ten years.

unearthed.ex: Farmers unearthed old coins in the field.

unearthing.ex: The reporter is unearthing new facts about the case.
unearthing.ja: 掘り起こすこと；見つけ出すこと

example.en: Journalists unearthed new evidence of the fraud.
example.zh: 記者發掘出這起詐騙的新證據。

note.usage: 原意為從地下挖出，引申為找出隱藏的事實、證據或缺陷。

noteHi.exampleTr: पत्रकारों ने धोखाधड़ी के नए सबूत खोज निकाले।
noteHi.meaning: छिपी हुई चीज़ को खोज निकालना।
noteHi.usage: मूल अर्थ ज़मीन से खोदना; अब तथ्य, सबूत या खामियाँ खोजने के लिए।

noteEs.exampleTr: Los periodistas descubrieron nuevas pruebas del fraude.
noteEs.meaning: sacar a la luz algo oculto.
noteEs.usage: Significa desenterrar; también hechos, pruebas o fallos ocultos.

noteJa.exampleTr: 記者たちはその詐欺の新たな証拠を掘り起こした。
noteJa.meaning: 隠れたものを見つけ出す。
noteJa.usage: 元は「地中から掘り出す」。事実・証拠・欠陥を見つける意味でも使う。

noteKo.exampleTr: 기자들은 그 사기의 새로운 증거를 찾아냈다.
noteKo.usage: 원래 '땅에서 파내다'의 뜻이며, 사실·증거·결함을 찾아낼 때도 쓴다.

noteEn.meaning: to find something that was hidden.
noteEn.usage: Literally 'dig up'; also used for facts, evidence or flaws.

unfused.ex: Unfused bones show the animal was young.

unusual.ex: It is unusual for the bank to speak during trading.

upper.ex: Upper income groups pay more tax.

valuable.en: worth a lot of money or very useful

example.en: The report is a valuable resource for voters.
example.zh: 這份報告對選民是寶貴的資源。

noteHi.exampleTr: यह रिपोर्ट मतदाताओं के लिए मूल्यवान संसाधन है।

noteEs.exampleTr: El informe es un recurso valioso para los votantes.

noteJa.exampleTr: その報告書は有権者にとって貴重な資料だ。

vertebrae.en: the small bones that form the backbone (vertebra)

virtually.ex: The road was virtually empty at night.

were.ex: The shops were closed on Sunday.

western.ex: The western Pacific has many typhoons.

whale.ex: A whale swam close to the shore.

will.en: used to talk about the future
will.ex: The new bridge will open next year.

workers.ex: The workers asked for a pay rise.
